info.name: Capmo REST Organisation Companies Project Room Listings API

params.name: order_by
params.description: Field to order by. It can be any field of the entity.

params.name: order_direction
params.description: Order direction of the `order_by` field. It can be `asc` or `desc`.

params.name: after
params.description: The last element from the previous page. This is a cursor. It will be returned in the output to be used in the next request. When it is not present, the first page is returned. When it is `null`, there are no more pages.

params.name: limit
params.description: How many items should be in the output.

items.docs: This can be used to list all room listings in a project in a paginated response.
